headline: How to Get Turbo
title: How to Get Turbo in Aniimo | Nimbi Level 21 and Alpha Turbo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Turbo is the final form of Nimbi, a Wind support Aniimo from Nimbus Fields. First, raise your Nimbi to level twenty one. Next, defeat an Alpha Turbo in Nimbus Fields, which only needs to be done once. Then evolve your Nimbi to unlock Turbo. A Rainstorm form of Turbo also appears in Nimbus Fields during rain or storms. Are you team Turbo? Comment below!
description: Turbo in Aniimo evolves from Nimbi at level 21 after you defeat an Alpha Turbo in Nimbus Fields.
